title: The story is about a boy named Sasha Saveliev who lives with his grandparents. His childhood is not peaceful and serene: Sasha is surrounded by the tyrannical love and despotism of his closest relatives. Their home is a battlefield, where the family is at war with each other with extreme cruelty. What is the price of love gained in this way?

title: The solo performance Bury Me Behind the Baseboard is a sad and funny conversation with the audience. It is about how difficult it is for a child to break through loneliness and navigate the unfriendly, complex, and incomprehensible adult world that has been built around him by loved ones.
